Releases: example-org/fastlib

fastlib v2.4.0

Latest
18 Sep v2.4.0 9f3c2e1

What's changed

  • Decoding is now streaming by default: large documents no longer need to fit in memory (#1840)
  • New strict_keys option rejects duplicate object keys instead of keeping the last one (#1852)
  • Fixed a crash when a document ended inside a surrogate pair (#1799)

Upgrading

The max_depth default drops from 1024 to 512. Pass it explicitly to keep the old limit:

decoder = Decoder(max_depth=1024)

Full changelog: v2.3.2...v2.4.0
